CHIM Cached Connector v1.7.8 - Package Contents
================================================

Compatible with: CHIM 2.4.3+
Release Date: 2026-04-23

PACKAGE STRUCTURE
-----------------

CORE FILES (Required - Minimum for connector to function):
- conf/conf_schema.json              - Connector registration + diary settings schema
- lib/core/llm_connector.class.php   - Connector instantiation
- ui/core/llm_connectors.php         - Configuration UI with cache management
- connector/openrouterjsoncached.php - Main connector (v1.7.8)
- connector/openrouterjsoncached_helpers.php - Helper functions

UPSTREAM OVERWRITES (Replace upstream files - marked with BEGIN/END comments):
- lib/data_functions.php             - handlesSentenceSplitting + LOCATION_BLACKLIST fix + diary classifier filter
- lib/chat_helper_functions.php      - PRESERVE_ASTERISKS mode + offerDiary() injection function
- lib/dynamic_update_util.php        - incrementDiaryEventCounter() for event-based diary generation
- prompts/dialogue_prompt.php        - Minimize Quality Instructions feature
- main.php                           - Diary injection wiring + event counter calls
- conf/conf.sample.php               - Default values for diary settings
- ui/global_settings.php             - Save bug fix + cached connector compatibility filter
- ui/core/tmpl/metadata_json_editor.php - Diary settings in profile editor UI
- ui/core/tmpl/override_editor.php   - NPC override editor with diary settings
- ui/core/npc_master.php             - Diary settings in per-NPC override editor
- ui/core/core_profiles.php          - Profile page with deprecated AUTO_DIARY_WAIT toggle removed

DOCUMENTATION:
- CHANGELOG.txt
- PACKAGE_CONTENTS.txt (this file)
- INSTALLATION_INSTRUCTIONS.txt
- connector/OPENROUTERJSONCACHED_README.md

WHAT EACH CATEGORY MEANS
-------------------------

CORE FILES: The connector itself plus its registration in CHIM's systems.
These are the minimum required files. Without them, the connector does not
appear in the UI and cannot be used.

UPSTREAM OVERWRITES: Modified versions of CHIM 2.4.3 files. These contain
small, clearly marked modifications. Installing them replaces the upstream
version. Each modification is bracketed with:
  // --- BEGIN CACHED CONNECTOR MODIFICATION ---
  // --- END CACHED CONNECTOR MODIFICATION ---
Or for diary features:
  // --- BEGIN DIARY INJECTION ---
  // --- END DIARY INJECTION ---

INSTALLATION SCENARIOS
----------------------

Scenario 1: Full Installation (Recommended)
- Install ALL files (Core + Overwrites)
- All features available including diary injection and event-based diary generation

Scenario 2: Core Only (Safe, Partial Features)
- Install Core files only (no upstream overwrites)
- Connector works with main features
- Missing: immediate simple-format streaming, PRESERVE_ASTERISKS,
  LOCATION_BLACKLIST fix, diary injection, save bug fix

Scenario 3: Core + Select Overwrites
- Install Core files + only the overwrites you want
- e.g. Skip diary features but keep save bug fix and streaming improvements

Scenario 4: Quick Restore After CHIM Update
1. Install Core files to restore connector
2. Install Overwrites after reviewing CHIM changes

| Feature                       | File(s)                               | Category      |
|-------------------------------|---------------------------------------|---------------|
| Connector itself              | connector/openrouterjsoncached*.php   | Core          |

| LOCATION_BLACKLIST fix        | lib/data_functions.php                | Overwrite     |
| Diary classifier filter       | lib/data_functions.php                | Overwrite     |
| Preserve Asterisk Content     | lib/chat_helper_functions.php         | Overwrite     |
| Diary injection (offerDiary)  | lib/chat_helper_functions.php         | Overwrite     |
| Diary injection wiring        | main.php                              | Overwrite     |
| Event-based diary generation  | lib/dynamic_update_util.php           | Overwrite     |
| Diary settings defaults       | conf/conf.sample.php                  | Overwrite     |
| Diary profile UI              | ui/core/tmpl/metadata_json_editor.php | Overwrite     |
| Diary per-NPC overrides       | ui/core/npc_master.php                | Overwrite     |
| Minimize Quality Instructions | prompts/dialogue_prompt.php           | Overwrite     |
| Save error visibility         | ui/global_settings.php                | Overwrite     |
| Connector type compatibility  | ui/global_settings.php                | Overwrite     |
| Disable Refusal Filter        | connector/openrouterjsoncached.php    | Core (built-in)|
